summary: Make striptags remove tags and comments that contain newlines by compiling the tag/comment regexes with re.DOTALL. Add a regression test that demonstrates tags/comments with embedded newlines are removed.
risks: Minimal. Changing the regex to use DOTALL will allow '.' to match newlines, which is the intended behavior for stripping multi-line tags/comments. The simple regex-based stripping is still not a full HTML parser, so edge cases involving malformed HTML may behave differently, but this change restores previous behavior and matches the reported expectation.
warning: LLM patch draft. Not applied, tested, or approved. Review before Docker execution.
